message.reasoning: We need rating. The test is for DexPool with removeLiquidity returning proportional reserves, uses getReserves which DEX contract does not have. Also event args differ. So not directly adaptable. Pattern of removing liquidity and checking balances could be useful but DEX has removeLiquidity similar but no approve needed and event signature different. Could be partially useful. Rating 1.
